summary: FINAL gate QA for CR-124, BUG-041, BUG-042, BUG-043 and CR-125. Block A V1-V20: 20/20 PASS (V11 now passes after the BUG-042 fix). Block B B1-B11: 11/11 PASS. Block D D1-D5: 5/5 PASS in the browser. Block C regression: C1 CR-085 22/22, C2 CR-100 8/8, C3 CR-089 20 pass + 1 pre-existing skip, C4 CR-093 20 pass + 1 skip, C6 intl_phone all pass (1 skip because the record already exists), C7 qa_full 28/28. C5 CR-096: 13/15. The 2 failures are test-data and rate-limit artifacts, not regressions (see notes). No code defects found in the session's changes. Environment: the external SSO preprod.mygenie.online stopped responding for about 10 minutes (11:31-11:43 UTC), so /api/auth/login returned 504 after the backend's 10s httpx timeout. After it recovered, every affected suite was rerun and passed.

minor.issue: ENV NOTE: the upstream MyGenie SSO hung for about 10 min, so login returned 504 (routers/auth.py timeout=10.0). A healthy login also takes about 20s at peak. Not caused by this session.

TEST DATA DRIFT: the supposedly unknown phone 9000000001 exists as customer d5ccc45f 'BrandNewUser' in pos_0001_restaurant_689 (created 2026-10-11), so linked=True is correct behaviour. The test should use a phone that is guaranteed to be unused.
Got 429 from the start because of repeated QA runs within the rate-limit window. Expected, not a defect. It passed on the first run of the session.
The suite targets r689 (Kunafa Mahal). CRM_TEST_OWNER_EMAIL must be owner@kunafamahal.com, not cafe103. With cafe103, test_FM fails because of the restaurant mismatch.
Passes on a fresh run. Back-to-back reruns give 429 'Too many lookups' (rate limit, expected).

issues: The preview row shows row.phone without the country_code prefix (CustomersPage.jsx ~2975), even though the API now returns country_code. Optional UX polish.
The UI offers 8 country codes while the backend recognises 22 (CR-125). Guests from +27/+7/+34/+62/+234/+254 etc. cannot pick their code in the QR or edit dropdowns. Informational, product decision.
DOB and Anniversary use the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar. Pre-existing.

critical_code_review_comments: core/phone.py: known-prefix detection tries the longest prefix first (4,3,2,1). Verified for +7/+27/+34/+62/+234/+254/+44/+91. Unknown '+' prefixes still fall back to the greedy 1-4 digit regex, which can mis-split numbers from countries outside the list (e.g. +2547... is fine, but +880 Bangladesh would split as +880 by luck, and +2xx unknowns are at risk). Low risk, noted in iteration_2 as well.
core/whatsapp.py:836 BUG-041 fix verified: (customer.get('country_code') or '+91'). Line 913 is also null-safe.

routers/customers.py:1635/1645 use result.get('country_code','+91'), which would not default if the key exists with value None. That is safe today because _validate_and_classify_row always sets cc from normalize_phone.

success_rate.backend: 100% of session-scope checks (V1-V20 and B1-B11). Regression: 129/131 executed, and both failures are non-defects
